skill.name: easycad
skill.usageExample: 帮我安装 EasyCAD 并启动，我想用一句话生成一个带四个安装孔的轴承座三维模型。

description.zh: 下载、安装并启动 EasyCAD——许愿式 AI CAD 客户端。自动识别 macOS（Apple 芯片/Intel）与 Windows 平台选择对应安装包，完成安装、首次启动与验证；装好后用一句话即可生成可导出 STEP/STL 的参数化三维模型，Agent 底座 Easy Code 随客户端自动配置。
description.en: Download, install and launch EasyCAD, the wish-style AI CAD client. Detects macOS (Apple silicon/Intel) and Windows automatically, picks the matching installer, then completes install, first launch and verification. Once set up, one sentence produces a parametric 3D model exportable as STEP/STL, with the Easy Code agent runtime configured automatically.
